message.content: The workshop's room change from Room 1 to Room 4 is well supported by the booking ledger (S2). The claim that every registered attendee received the change notice before noon remains unresolved: although 18 emails were sent (S3), delivery and receipt are unconfirmed, and the registration ledger (S1) shows only 18 attendees, contradicting the claim of 20. Given this, the coordinator can report the room change occurred but cannot definitively confirm that all participants received the notice.
